summary.name: Pinto Notes
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source notes app for iPhone and Mac that ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex can read and edit over MCP, with each AI edit highlighted and undoable.
keywords: give ai access to my notes
use_cases: Let ChatGPT or Claude read your notes for personal planning
Plan runs, trips or weekly schedules with an AI editing the same note
Split shared costs with a friend inside a note
Migrate notes from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote or Keep
Give coding agents a shared notebook that logs their work
Track habits or budgets using template notes
summary.what_it_does: Pinto Notes is a notes app for iPhone and Mac styled after Apple Notes, with checklists, tables, folders and links between notes. AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code and Codex can search and edit the same notes over MCP, and the page says each AI change is highlighted and can be undone. Every change is marked as made by you or by a specific AI. Notes can be encrypted on-device before syncing, and individual notes can be locked with a separate password. The page also says it can import notes from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote and Keep, and offers templates such as a trip plan and budget tracker. Sharing with other people is listed as coming soon.
notable: Open source, with code publicly available on GitHub
AI edits over MCP are highlighted, attributed to the specific AI, and undoable
Imports notes from Apple Notes, Obsidian, Bear, Evernote and Keep
Page cites an internal study: 18% recall without notes vs 82.5% with Pinto in a new chat
caveats: Sharing notes with other people is marked as coming soon
Page is mostly marketing; the recall figures come from the vendor's own study and are not independently verified
